rulings: zh-legal-lead: only 明确 is removed; the remaining sentence is verbatim current and now matches the ar/en after-text and the intro's implied acceptance; the reader (#20) read it cleanly as acceptance by use. zh-legal-mascot: only the species word changes, 白耳鹎 to 白颊鹎, which is the standard Chinese name of Pycnonotus leucogenys (white-cheeked bulbul) and agrees with the owner's «أبيض الخدين»; the blind reader recognised it (#21). The reader's remark that no name or the word mascot is given is source-level and out of scope. zh-qarah-fee: the new source line is rendered as one ticket covering both sites, sold at the village; currency form 成人每位 50 沙特里亚尔（SAR） and the card's own village name 文明之地（Land of Civilisations）遗产村落 are kept exactly; 卡拉山 is the termbase form (Al-Qarah Mountain); the judge edit cures the fragment clause. No child fare, no payment channel, no hours. zh-hadarat-fee: the source after-text is silent on where the ticket is sold, so the card says only one ticket covers both sites and no purchase place is added (coordinator decision 2); the page itself writes 文明之地 and 卡拉山 bare throughout, so no quotes or English gloss are added here (reader #4/#6 stay as page-level, source-level observations). zh-stores-bisht: only the UNESCO clause changes, now attributed to the bisht as such with no Hasawi attribution; the rest of the answer is verbatim current. Termbase gap: there is no entry whose en is an UNESCO Intangible Cultural Heritage list term (the only UNESCO entries are the World Heritage ones), so no note is appended for 非物质文化遗产名录; it is the standard generic Chinese name of the list and the owner or a later batch may bind it. zh-plan.tableEvent: 活动 equals nav.events and the termbase Events entry (one word, no punctuation); the template renders it full-width without a space, 椰枣村（活动）, which cures reader remark #16 on the brackets; Palm Village stays 椰枣村 per termbase. Termbase: the white-eared bulbul character entry is superseded by the owner ruling OQ-L1 and gets an appended note. Score 94: meaning exact on all six; the two fee cards are slightly less informative than the Qarah one because the source is silent, which is a source-level limit and no deduction beyond cultural fit.
